Ice Shot — Deadeye

Cold-Conversion Bow Attack  •  Ranger → Deadeye  •  Path of Exile 2 (patch 0.5)

A crit + freeze bow build around Ice Shot: fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards, all converted to cold. Stack flat cold, every “increased” damage bucket at once (physical, cold, elemental-with-attacks, projectile), critical strikes and freeze. Built and verified inside this repository's Path of Building 2 engine — an all-rare, no-unique EndGame setup at realistic (non-mirror) rolls reads ~3.6 million combined DPS (all projectiles) while evading 63% of hits, with capped resistances and every slot filled.

Every number here is read straight out of this repository's Path of Building 2 calculation engine (run headless via LuaJIT) for the exact build below — all-rare gear, no uniques, every modifier a real in-game prefix/suffix at realistic (non-mirror) rolls, all 10 slots filled and resistances capped. Gear priorities follow the community Ice Shot Deadeye guides (Maxroll / Mobalytics). See How the damage is counted below.

Ice Shot 5-link + Spirit

Ice Shotgem 20 → eff. 30
80% Phys→Cold. Fires an arrow that sprays a 300° cone of ice shards on hit (100% Phys→Cold). +to Level of all Projectile Skills (bow +3, amulet +3, quiver +2 — all normal suffixes) plus Cold Mastery puts Ice Shot at effective level 30 → 14 shards per shot. The shards are the build's main damage.
Cold PenetrationSupport T2
Enemies have −30% Cold Resistance against your hits — a big multiplier on bosses now that there's no penetration unique. Pairs with the tree's Storm Swell / Glaciation pen.
Inevitable CriticalsSupport T3
Accumulates up to +100% increased Critical Hit Chance while you keep attacking a target — your crit enabler on bosses.
Biting FrostSupport T4
+40% more damage to Frozen enemies, +20% more vs Frozen unique/bosses. The freeze multiplier that pushes the build past 2M.
SupercriticalSupport T3
+100% critical damage bonus (−20% crit chance). Multiplies every crit.
Cold MasterySupport T5
+1 to Ice Shot's level — a flat bump to the base damage multiplier and shard count.
Herald of Ice (Spirit)Spirit 30
Shatter chain-explosions for map clear (not part of the single-target number). Reserves 30 Spirit.
Wind Dancer (Spirit)Spirit 30
Periodic Evasion stages → big evasion + a knockback nova when hit. Your main defensive layer. Reserves 30 Spirit.
Herald of Thunder (Spirit)Spirit 30
Extra lightning AoE on shocked kills for additional clear coverage. Reserves 30 Spirit (90/100 total used).

Passive tree (level 90)

113 passives + 8 Deadeye ascendancy points: an evasion core (Catlike Agility, Blur, Careful Consideration) layered onto the cold / projectile / critical / freeze / attack-speed clusters, with three jewel sockets (purple). The tree was built with PoB's Show Node Power in two passes (distance 15): first Evasion power to buy the 63% evade floor in the fewest points (~24), then Full DPS power for the remaining ~89 — so the defensive layer costs the least possible damage. Generic +Attribute passives are mostly Dexterity (accuracy/requirements) with twelve set to Intelligence to clear Herald of Ice's 86 Int. Tree version 0_4 (the engine's data; the 0.5 tree is materially identical here).

How the damage is counted

Ice Shot has two parts the engine scores per projectile: the Arrow (1–2 projectiles) and the Shards — a 300° cone of 13 projectiles that convert 100% of Physical to Cold. Against a boss you stand point-blank so the whole cone overlaps the target (a “shotgun”). The headline is the app's own per-projectile Total DPS × the projectile count (14, set by Ice Shot's effective gem level) — identical to how Path of Building handles other cone/nova skills (e.g. its Shrapnel Ballista “# of Shotgunning Projectiles” option).
Shard hit, per projectile (engine Total DPS)226,632
× ice shards in the cone (all overlap)× 14
Combined shard DPS3,172,848
+ arrows (217,012 × 2)+434,024
Total combined DPS3,606,872

Enemy state: Pinnacle boss, Chilled & Frozen, power & frenzy charges up. The Mirage Deadeye archer (ascendancy) adds a clone that also fires Ice Shot in-game — real DPS is meaningfully higher than this number, which the calculator does not model, so real DPS is higher than this 3.6M. This build deliberately trades raw damage for survivability — a pure-damage tree pushes 5M+ but evades far less.

Defensive model. An evasion / dodge build: ~2.3k Life, capped 75% elemental resistances, pure-evasion bases on every armour slot + the tree evasion core (16,571 Evasion → 63% evade), Wind Dancer, and permanent Chill/Freeze that stops most incoming hits before they land — lifting Effective HP to 12,320. Physical is the weak point (no armour, 2,382 phys max hit). To harden further: add more % maximum Life passives (Behemoth / Unbending) and chase a higher attack-speed/crit bow to claw back the damage spent on evasion.

Levels 1 – 12 — Act 1 — Start leveling (Ice Shot comes at 31)

Ice Shot isn't available yet — it's a Tier 9 gem that needs level 31. Level Act 1 with Lightning Arrow (plus Escape Shot and Frost Bomb), but spend every passive and gear slot building the cold / projectile core you'll switch Ice Shot into at 31. Lead with raw damage and movement; defence is just life + resists off rares.

Ascendancy this stage: None yet

Gear priorities

SlotItemWhy
BowAny bow with high % Physical Damage + flat PhysicalA solid phys/attack-speed bow carries Lightning Arrow now and converts straight into cold once Ice Shot comes online.
QuiverRare with flat Cold to Attacks, attack speed, +LifeStart stacking flat cold now — it gets multiplied hard the moment you swap to Ice Shot.
ArmourEvasion rares with +Life and any ResistancesJust survive; grab +Dex to meet bow/gem requirements (Ice Shot will want 72 Dex).
FlasksLife + Mana flasksKeep them rolling; your bow skills are mana-hungry while leveling.

Skills & links

How gems unlock in PoE 2. Your main skill Ice Shot is a Tier 9 gem — engraved from a Level 9 Uncut Skill Gem and requiring character level 31 (72 Dex), so it is not available early. You level with a starter bow skill (Lightning Arrow, plus Escape Shot / Frost Bomb) until level 31, then swap your links onto Ice Shot. A skill gem also starts with only 2 support slots — open the 3rd / 4th / 5th with a Lesser / Greater / Perfect Jeweller's Orb. Supports are crafted from Uncut Support Gems; the T# badge is the Uncut Support Gem tier you need, and higher tiers only drop deeper in the campaign. Spirit gems (Heralds, Wind Dancer) reserve 30 Spirit each — your first +30 Spirit comes from the Ominous Altars quest in Freythorn (Act 1).
Lightning ArrowLv 1
Your level-1 leveling skill until Ice Shot unlocks at 31 — chains lightning between enemies for fast clear. Drop it on your first Uncut Skill Gem.
Martial Tempo (support)Support T1
One of your first two support slots — more attack speed for smoother clear and a clean linear damage boost.
Scattershot / Pierce (support)Support T1
Your second starter slot: extra projectiles or pierce for campaign clear. You only have 2 slots until your first Jeweller's Orb.
Escape Shot · Frost BombLv 1
Leveling utility, both usable from level 1: Escape Shot freezes and repositions you out of dangerous packs; Frost Bomb adds Cold Exposure.
Herald of Ice (Spirit)Spirit 30 · Freythorn
Grab your first 30 Spirit from the Ominous Altars quest in Freythorn (kill The King in the Mists, consume the Gembloom Skull), then socket it. Shatter explosions chain-clear frozen packs.

Levels 13 – 30 — Acts 2–3 — Projectiles & 1st ascension (still pre-Ice Shot)

Keep leveling with Lightning Arrow while you build out the projectile/cold cluster and take your first ascendancy. Endless Munitions (an extra projectile) is the single best Deadeye point for this build. A Lesser Jeweller's Orb opens your 3rd support slot. (Ice Shot still unlocks at level 31 — next tab.)

Levels 31 – 50 — Lvl 31: Ice Shot unlocks — crit & 2nd ascension

At level 31, swap to Ice Shot (Tier 9 — engrave it from a Level-9 Uncut Skill Gem, needs 72 Dex) and move your supports onto it. Now transition into critical strikes: grab crit-chance / crit-damage notables and crit supports. Deadeye's Far Shot (Projectile Proximity) and Gathering Winds (Tailwind) add a 'more' multiplier and free attack speed. A Greater Jeweller's Orb opens your 4th support slot.

Ascendancy this stage: Far Shot + Gathering Winds (2nd trial, ~lvl 35–45)

Helmet% increased Critical Hit Chance, +Life, AccuracyCrit chance is the gateway to your crit multiplier.
Glovesflat Cold + % Critical Damage Bonus + attack speedCrit damage scales hard once crit chance is respectable.
Ringsflat Cold to Attacks, % Cold Damage, Life, ResTwo big flat-cold rings; +Dex to keep meeting the bow requirement.

Levels 51 – 70 — Power spike — rares & final links

Assemble the final support set and start replacing leveling pieces with proper rares. This build runs all rares, no uniques — the boss penetration that a unique amulet would give is covered instead by the Cold Penetration support and the tree's pen nodes (Storm Swell / Glaciation). Use a Perfect Jeweller's Orb to open the 5th support slot for the full link.

Ascendancy this stage: Mirage Deadeye / finish 8 points (3rd trial, ~lvl 55–68)

Levels 71 – 90 — Finish the tree & jewels

Fill the last damage clusters, socket three rare jewels, and finish your 8 ascendancy points. With ~100 Spirit from the campaign you can now run all three Spirit gems (Herald of Ice + Wind Dancer + Herald of Thunder). From here it is pure gear optimisation toward the EndGame sheet on the next tab.
